description: Deletes a specific Trello action, such as a `commentCard`, by its ID; this is an irreversible operation and only applies to deletable action types, as many (especially system-generated) actions cannot be deleted.

idAction.description: The ID of the Trello action to be deleted (typically a 24-character hexadecimal string).
idAction.title: Id Action

DeleteActionResponse.description: Response schema for `DeleteAction`. DELETE endpoint returns an empty response body. Only the HTTP status code should be relied upon for validation.
